ruleDefinitions.name: Allow Service Access Using Security Descriptor Tampering Via Sc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications to allow access to a service from a suspicious trustee. This can be used to override access restrictions set by previous ACLs.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "sc\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*sdset.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*A\\;.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;IU.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;SU.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;BA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;SY.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;WD.*")))
